Use only sources released so far; cutoffs are inclusive unless explicitly stated otherwise. Recompute from the authored inputs, retaining every unamended constraint. sources.text: Synthetic packet: The original trustee sheet supplies par buckets, principal cash and interest cash. Principal cash is separate from interest receipts and cannot directly pay coupons.

Synthetic governing terms: All amounts are USD millions. Adjusted collateral equals total asset par plus principal cash, less the defaulted-par credit shortfall and haircut on nondefault low-rated par above ccc_limit. Defaulted and nondefault low-rated buckets never overlap. Coverage tests use principal before any diversion. Expenses and both stipulated interest coupons are paid first; all remaining interest goes to equity if both tests pass, otherwise to senior principal. When permitted, one whole new loan may be bought using principal cash only. Maximize current equity payout, then adjusted collateral, then alphabetical action label. No partial purchase or other trade is allowed.

outputs.description: Pre-distribution coverage-test numerator after selected principal action.

outputs.name: senior_coverage
outputs.description: Adjusted collateral divided by senior principal before diversion.

outputs.name: combined_coverage
outputs.description: Adjusted collateral divided by senior plus mezzanine principal before diversion.

outputs.name: cash_distributions
outputs.description: [senior interest, mezzanine interest, senior principal diversion, equity] in order.

outputs.name: equity_release_permitted
outputs.description: Whether both pre-distribution coverage tests permit residual cash to equity.
